# ADMOV

> AI agency based in Istanbul, Türkiye. We build AI-generated video and photography,
> automation systems, LLM integrations, websites, apps and e-commerce stores for
> businesses in Türkiye and the Middle East. The site is published in English,
> Arabic and Turkish.

Contact: info@admov.io

## Services
- AI Generated Videos — cinematic product and brand video produced with generative models
- AI Generated Photos — product and lifestyle photography at scale, without a studio shoot
- AI Automation Systems — n8n and Make workflows for lead handling, reporting and operations
- LLM Setup & Integration — custom assistants and AI features wired into existing tools
- Website Development — marketing sites and web apps
- App Development — mobile applications
- Meta, Google & TikTok Ads — paid acquisition and creative testing
- Shopify & E-Commerce — full store builds and ongoing management

## Products we build and run
- i8chat (https://i8chat.com) — turns Instagram comments into DMs with your link, via the official Instagram API. Live.
- ContentOS (https://creatorflow-alpha-three.vercel.app) — content operations studio for agencies. Arabic-first, bilingual. Coming soon.
- CreatorFlow (https://creatorflow-studio-six.vercel.app) — trend discovery and content production pipeline for creators. Coming soon.
- Vivaldi (https://vivaldi-gold.vercel.app) — AI upholstery preview: see a sofa in new fabric before it is reupholstered. Coming soon.
